lines.text: He's too cheap to buy lunch.

data.define: Describes a stingy person; it can also mean low quality.

example.text: He's too cheap to buy lunch.

misuse.text: Don't call grandma 'cheap' for using coupons.

data.l1_hook: Nó không bao giờ trả tiền ăn trưa!
data.l1_ex: Nó cheap quá, không chịu bao bữa trưa.

native.caption:
“cheap” nghĩa là gì?
“cheap” = Keo kiệt.
Ví dụ: “He's too cheap to buy lunch.” (Nó cheap quá, không chịu bao bữa trưa.)
